frontmatter.retries: number (mirror of QA failures written by `work verify --fail`)
frontmatter.followups: number (non-blocking QA findings filed as follow-up tickets)

skillChainFormat: {"autoReport": true, "maxDepth": 5 or {"*": 5, "Consultant": 8} (cap 10), "followSkills": "router" (default: skills reached from non-entry skills are indexed with ↗ but not expanded) or "all"} regenerates skill-chains/SUMMARY.md (and archives old records) after every skill-load; default false = only on dashboard/skill-report
milestoneFormat: [{"id": "M0", "stage": "spike|feature|hardening"}] (plain string ids are allowed; stage defaults to feature)
